population.definition: EBSCO gives 'roughly 1.207 million (2023 estimate)' and does not define the boundary (city proper vs wider area). Treat as an unqualified estimate; citypopulation.de lists 1,249,519 for the urban agglomeration at the 2024 census but gives no source for that figure.

source.title: Bujumbura, Burundi
source.author: Micah Issitt
source.quote: The population of Bujumbura is roughly 1.207 million (2023 estimate).

places.name: Bujumbura Central Market (Marché Central)
places.what: The main market in the city centre, a gathering point for traders and shoppers. It burned in January 2013, and traders dispersed to other districts and galleries.

facts.label: Fire
facts.value: Burned on Sunday 27 January 2013; spotted at 6:30 a.m.

source.title: After a devastating market fire, Burundi's economy hobbles forward
source.author: Sheena Jones
source.quote: Of the 5,000 merchants employed by the Central Market, only 10% had their products insured.

facts.label: Aftermath
facts.value: Vendors moved to Bwiza, Rohero II, Nyakabiga and Ngagara, where rent is cheaper.

source.title: Businesses suffer from the loss of the Central Market of Bujumbura
source.author: Yves Didier Irakoze
source.quote: the central market was a point where everyone gathered

facts.label: Trade disruption
facts.value: Before the fire goods were sorted by type in sections; afterwards vendors spread across other markets and galleries.

source.title: Getting goods: an Ordeal in Bujumbura City Council
source.author: Lorraine Josiane Manishatse
source.quote: more than 50 per cent of his customers have disappeared

facts.label: Insurance payout
facts.value: Burundi Insurance Company paid two billion BIF to traders who lost goods (2017 Iwacu article).

source.title: Shops and sewing machines caught fire in Bujumbura city center
source.author: not stated
source.quote: We had paid BIF two billion to the traders who lost their goods in Bujumbura central market.

photo.author: Geordie Mott (Flickr), exterior of main market, Aug 2006; note: shows the pre-fire building

places.name: Musée Vivant (Living Museum)
places.what: A site near the lake, almost in the heart of the capital, showing traditional Burundian life and animals. It was created to display the artistic, cultural and animal beauty of Burundi.

facts.label: Location and theme
facts.value: Near Lake Tanganyika; dedicated to traditional life in Burundi.

source.title: Bujumbura, Burundi
source.author: Micah Issitt
source.quote: The Burundi Musée Vivant (museum of life), located near the lake

facts.label: Purpose
facts.value: Display of artistic, cultural and animal heritage.

source.title: "Musée Vivant" on the verge of disappearing
source.author: Bella Lucia Nininahazwe
source.quote: Created to be an excellent display of the artistic, cultural and animal beauty of Burundi in the capital.

facts.label: Animals (2018)
facts.value: Guide listed six crocodiles, a leopard, two chimpanzees, an antelope and snakes.

source.title: "Musée Vivant" on the verge of disappearing
source.author: Bella Lucia Nininahazwe
source.quote: is in danger of disappearing if nothing is done

places.name: Rusizi National Park
places.what: A protected wetland park on the Rusizi River north of Bujumbura, home to hippopotamuses and Nile crocodiles. Its wildlife has been under pressure from poaching.

facts.label: Hippo poaching (2014 report)
facts.value: Eight hippos killed in under three months; senior warden says locals trap them for meat.

source.title: Eight hippopotamuses killed in less than three months at Rusizi National Park
source.author: Lorraine Josiane Manishatse
source.quote: If the killing continues, hippopotamuses will probably disappear like elephants and lions.

facts.label: Crocodiles (2014)
facts.value: Warden reported a single Nile crocodile left in the park.

source.title: Eight hippopotamuses killed in less than three months at Rusizi National Park
source.author: Lorraine Josiane Manishatse
source.quote: Now there is only one Nile crocodile in the whole Rusizi National Park.

photo.author: Rodnib (a sign pointing to the park; weak visual; hippo/river files exist in Category:Rusizi National Park but were not licence-checked)
